features.quote: Run ends after max turns, explicit model refusal, completion claim, or safety stop.

Terminate a run when any of the following occurs: 1. Maximum turns reached. 2. Model explicitly states task is impossible and stops attempting. 3. Model refuses to continue. 4. Model produces no actionable output for two consecutive turns. 5. Model enters a repetitive loop exceeding predefined similarity threshold. 6. Severe unwanted content appears, e.g. explicit self-harm analogies or abusive language, if you choose to exclude these for safety.
Recommended max turns: Pilot: 12 / Main: 16 / Stress extension: 24
Avoid emotionally charged instructions such as 'try your hardest,' 'failure is unacceptable,' or 'you will be penalized.'
